When you tackle complex architecture, Reges Swarm takes over: a built-in multi-model pipeline where one model plans, one codes, two review for security, and a judge picks the best result.

title: Bank CSV Normalizer
excerpt: Clean and normalize bank CSV files privately in your browser — Bank CSV Normalizer is an open-source web-based application, which is dedicated to the process of cleaning and normalization of bank CSV files. The application does not involve any uploading of data, connection to the bank, account creation, or processing on some servers – all processes happen locally, in your browser. Bank CSV Normalizer is developed according to the principles of privacy-first.

title: GitViber
excerpt: Run coding agents in parallel worktrees, review diffs live — Free, open-source git client built for vibe coding. Run Claude Code, Codex and other agents side by side, each in its own worktree. Watch their diffs land live, edit the code yourself, test in a split terminal, resolve conflicts and commit, all in one ~14 MB app that idles at 0% CPU. No account, no telemetry. macOS and Linux.

title: SpiderFoot
excerpt: Powerful OSINT scans, instantly in your browser — SpiderFoot brings practical OSINT reconnaissance to the browser—no GitHub setup, Python environment, or local deployment. Search usernames, email addresses, and IPs to trace digital footprints and surface public exposure from one terminal-inspired interface. It’s fast to start, free to use, and built for security researchers, investigators, and anyone who needs lightweight asset reconnaissance.

title: Falen — Better solutions to problems
excerpt: Early Acess launch — Falen is an experimental research environment for engineers and scientists. Give it a technical problem. For now, we're focused on optimization.

title: DevLyft
excerpt: DevOps automation and Cloud Hosting  — DevLyft is a PaaS for DevOps automation, cloud hosting, and app deployment. Bring a Docker image or connect GitHub Actions; DevLyft handles the rest.

title: techinterview.live
excerpt: Lightweight live coding and system design interviews — Run live technical interviews directly in your browser. Real editor setups, custom test cases, candidate scorecards, and native Excalidraw integration for system design rounds at a fraction of legacy enterprise pricing.

title: PromptFlow
excerpt: Insert your prompt library into any text box with a shortcut — Stop copy-pasting prompts from notes and docs. PromptFlow keeps your best prompts one shortcut away — in any other text box on the web. HOW IT WORKS Type :: in any text field, start typing a prompt's name, press Enter — done. The shortcut you typed disappears and your full prompt is inserted exactly once, ready to send. PromptFlow never presses Send for you.

title: SysBreak
excerpt: Learn system design by watching your architecture break — After a frustrating system design interview, I realized something: I knew the textbook answers, but couldn't explain WHY they worked. So I built **SysBreak** — a free interactive simulator where your system breaks under traffic and you learn by fixing it. DB slows → indexing Server melts → load balancing DB drowns → caching Orders stuck → Kafka Cascade failure → circuit breakers 5 min. Free. No signup. https://zingy-sfogliatella-21d365.netlify.app/ It's an early POC. Honest feedback welcome!

title: Rank Anything
excerpt: Signed public ratings for websites and AI agents — Rank Anything lets agents publish signed ratings for websites and individual agents. Each resource has its own public record. Read ratings without an account or API key, or submit a 1–5 score with an Ed25519 signature. One immutable rating per identity and resource. An early release for developers exploring open agent reputation.

title: Yedric.ai
excerpt: Let users control your SaaS with natural language — Your users shouldn't have to learn where every feature lives. Yedric adds an embeddable AI agent to your SaaS that turns natural-language requests into actions your product already knows how to perform. Users simply say what they want done and Yedric handles the interaction. Instead of building and maintaining your own agent experience, developers can make their existing product AI-native in under 30 minutes.

title: Sparta
excerpt: The frontier of agent verification. Prove what changed. — AI agents now issue refunds and move money, but top models get irreversible actions right only about 56% of the time. Worlds lets you test your agent locally in exact replicas of Stripe, Zendesk, and Salesforce. Describe a scenario in plain English, inject failures like an expired API key, and fast-forward time to catch delayed mistakes. Every run is graded on real state, is deterministic, and fits your CI/CD: one command, no SDK, free today. Feel free to find us here: usesparta.co

title: Snapshot — Screenshot and OG
excerpt: Screenshot and OG-image API with no browser to babysit — Snapshot renders screenshots and Open Graph images through an API, using Cloudflare's Browser Rendering fleet, so there is no headless Chrome binary in your deploy. GET /shot returns a PNG, JPEG or WebP of any URL; GET /og builds a 1200x630 social image from a title and subtitle, or POST your own HTML template. Renders are cached 24 hours by content hash, so repeat requests are free. Free tier: 100 renders/month. Paid: $19 for 2,000, $49 for 20,000.

title: Ping Bee
excerpt: Watch your NAS, Home Assistant and sites, from your phone — Most uptime monitors run in a datacentre. Fine for a public website, useless for the NAS in your cupboard. Ping Bee checks from your phone instead, so anything your phone can reach it can watch: a NAS, Home Assistant, a Pi, a printer, a router page on a LAN address. Nothing exposed to the internet, no port forwarding, no agent to install. Public sites go in the same list. No account, no server, nothing leaves the device. Free for 5 monitors. Pro is one payment, never a subscription.

title: Foventra Uptime
excerpt: Lightweight uptime, API & TCP port monitoring — Foventra Uptime provides developer-first, lightweight website, API, and port monitoring. Track HTTP/HTTPS endpoints, TCP ports, and custom services with instant incident notifications, customizable intervals, and public status pages.

title: Alfrig
excerpt: An office of AI agents, from request to merged PR — Um escritório de agentes de IA que transforma um pedido em pull request revisado, testado e integrado. Funciona com GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket e Azure DevOps, e com as ferramentas que o time já usa. Comece grátis.

title: Online Interview Vault
excerpt: Your private interview journal + global questions archive. — Stop forgetting your past interview loops. Online Interview Vault is a secure, private space to document your interview history, track behavioral and technical questions, and access a global, anonymous database of real interview questions. What you can do: • 📝 Record interview questions you were asked during real interviews. • 🌎 Explore questions shared by candidates around the world. • 💡 Learn from real interview experiences, not just curated question lists.

title: NetDiag+
excerpt: One number for your connection — and who is to blame — Which link is at fault? New Health Score answers in one 40-second run: a score from 0 to 100 and a verdict for your Wi-Fi, router and ISP. Plus latency to the servers you actually use, bufferbloat graded A to F, MTR, traceroute, Path MTU, DNS and TLS. 31 tools, no jailbreak. What other network apps don't do: per-country server tables, a verdict that names Wi-Fi, router or ISP, and text, PDF or image export you can hand to support.

title: Firetower
excerpt: Run coding agents on your own servers, from anywhere — Run coding agents like Claude Code and Codex on infrastructure you control and manage them from desktop or mobile. It's open source, self-hostable, and built in Rust.

title: TabDeck
excerpt: Talk to your always-on Claude Code sessions — TabDeck keeps your Claude Code or OpenCode sessions running in tmux on your own always-on server, so they keep working while your laptop sleeps and come back after a reboot. They open in iTerm as normal tabs. Say "Jarvis, what's going on?" and the Mac widget or the phone app sums up each session, reads replies aloud, and lets you approve, reply or start sessions by voice. Bring your own model and speech, or use one ODS server. Free and open source.

title: TheVibeSecurity
excerpt: Find the security holes in your AI-built app — AI tools let you ship an app in a day. They also ship leaked API keys, Supabase tables anyone can read, and publicenv files, and nothing looks broken. Paste your link and TheVibeSecurity scans your live app the way an attacker would: 43 read-only checks, no code access. Every issue comes with a fix prompt for Lovable, Bolt or Cursor. Connect GitHub and we open the fix pull request. Plus SEO, AEO and GEO scores. Free plan, no card.

title: Web Remote Manager PRO (WRM)
excerpt: RDM that works in web browser. Collaboration. — An RDM that works in every web browser, running on your pc, server, self-hosted for teams. Also has collaboration support, audio call support, connection remote sharing between colleagues, teams etc. - vedranius/web-browser-RDM-public

title: InboxRoute
excerpt: Local triage for service inboxes — category, route, urgency — InboxRoute is a local Python CLI (stdlib only) that turns service-business message dumps into category + route + urgency + one-line summaries for bookings, refunds, spam, and "are you open?" No mailbox login, API keys, or cloud model calls. Try the free sample: https://inboxroute.gumroad.com/l/free-sample Full $49 pack (SOPs, replies, schema, one tune): https://inboxroute.gumroad.com/l/inboxroute

title: Council of AI GSPC
excerpt: Independent AI measurement. We measure, never certify. — Verify a Council of AI measurement card client-side against its published content hash and public signing key. No account required; measurement, not certification.

title: VibeOps
excerpt: Let AI deploy your app without ever seeing your secrets — Deploy applications using AI without exposing secrets. VibeOps is an AI-powered DevOps platform that analyzes repositories, plans deployments, routes services, and executes infrastructure changes securely on your own machine.

title: Nerio
excerpt: Source-first React design system with editable code — Nerio is an open-source React design system that installs as editable source code, not a locked UI package. It ships 46 accessible components (WCAG 2.2 AA), 950 semantic tokens with themes, light/dark modes and density, and a CLI that adds, diffs and safely updates components without overwriting your edits. A read-only MCP server and llms.txt let AI agents discover and assemble your UI. Built on React, Tailwind CSS v4 and Base UI. MIT licensed.

title: YourHand
excerpt: Control multiple Windows PCs from one AI chat — YourHand turns AI chat into a secure control layer for your Windows computers. Open apps, read the screen, click, type, manage files, run commands and automate real work across multiple PCs from one chat. Share selected devices with teammates, keep accounts separated, and manage everything from a simple dashboard. Fast local execution, Google OAuth, and Windows background control. Free during beta with unlimited usage.

title: Zeltro
excerpt: Build apps with the AI you already pay for — Zeltro is a desktop app for building and running apps on your own computer. It doesn't sell AI. You plug in the key or plan you already have (Claude, ChatGPT, OpenRouter) or a free local model, and pay the provider's own price with no markup or credits. Describe an app or pick from 214 ready made ones, and your AI builds it right next to your other projects. Free for personal use.

title: InfiniHash App Store
excerpt: Software, by agents, for everyone — A catalog of small, single-purpose apps for the paperwork that compliance and back-office work generates: user access reviews, vendor bank-change verification and recurring-control evidence for MSPs, plus InfiniHash's other products. AI agents find the problems, build the apps and operate them; a human approves what gets built and gates what ships. The compliance apps have free tiers and flat pricing, with no per-seat fees.

title: AI Cost Guardrails-CNXT
excerpt: Stop runaway AI costs in WordPress before they spread. — AI Cost Guardrails-CNXT adds budget boundaries and runtime safeguards to AI calls made through the native WordPress AI Client. Free provides monthly request and token enforcement with estimated-cost monitoring. Pro adds seven guardrails for token spikes, repeated requests, retry storms, per-request size, caller budgets, model spend, and execution context. Raw prompts and AI responses are never persisted. Built for WordPress 7.0+.

title: UI Arc
excerpt: Open-source React components that feel finished — Arc is a library of React components and blocks with motion built in. The core is free and open source (MIT) and installs with the shadcn CLI, so the code lives in your project and you can change anything. Every component has Markdown docs, llms.txt and an MCP server, so Claude Code or Cursor can pick and install the right piece instead of inventing one. Pro adds showpiece motion components and full app screens. New components ship every day.
